boundary: Order coincidences are not identifications. The Hoffman order-192 subgroup is W(D4), not the orientation-preserving tesseract group. Their central quotients are isomorphic to tomotope96. The Latin 96+192+288 census is an exact Q4 statistic, not by itself a torsor/group identification. q11 d=121, the all-odd rank theorem, and the exact Hoffman-shortened distance remain open.
